title: 7 Claude prompts that make you look 10 years more senior at work

hook.headline:
7 Claude Prompts
That Make You Look
10 Years More
Senior At Work

prompts.title: 1. Lead With The Answer
prompts.prompt: Here's my update: [paste]. Rewrite it so line one is the decision or ask, then 3 bullets of why. Cut anything my boss wouldn't miss.

prompts.title: 2. Imagine It Failed
prompts.prompt: It's 6 months from now and [project] failed. Give me the 5 most likely reasons, ranked, and one thing I can check this week for each.

prompts.title: 3. Read The Room First
prompts.prompt: I'm pitching [idea] to [names + roles]. For each person: what do they care about, what will they push back on, and what one line wins them over?

prompts.title: 4. Rehearse The Tough Questions
prompts.prompt: Act as a skeptical VP reviewing this: [paste]. Ask me the 5 hardest questions you'd ask in the meeting, then give me a 2-sentence answer to each.

prompts.title: 5. Say No Like A Director
prompts.prompt: I've been asked to take on [task] but I'm full with [projects]. Write a reply that backs the goal, offers 2 trade-offs, and asks which one to drop.

prompts.title: 6. Give Every Task An Owner
prompts.prompt: Here's a messy thread: [paste]. List what was decided, what's still open, and who owns each next step by when. Flag anything nobody owns.

prompts.title: 7. Make The Numbers Talk
prompts.prompt: Here's my data: [paste]. What are the 3 things a CFO would notice first, and what's the one chart that makes my point?
